en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Abdul Azeem Bin Abdullah Al Hasany, from Ali Bin Asbat, from Suleyman, a slave of Tirbal, from Hisham Al Jawaliqy who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[23:91] Glory be to Allah,
what is the Meaning of it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘His<sup>azwj</sup> Transcendence’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ahmad ibn Mihran has narrated from ‘Abd al-‘Azim ibn ‘Abdallah al-Hassani from Ali ibn Asbat. From Sulayman Mawla Tirbal from Hisham al-Jawaliqi who has said the following.
“I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the meaning of the words of Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious,
The Imam replied, “They denote Allah’s being above all things in perfection.”
